San Francisco IFR Clearance Phraseology Practice 3 (SFOW/28 SO Configuration)
Instructions: for each of the following flight plans, practice the full phraseology you would use when giving a voice clearance to the aircraft. Use abbreviated clearance phraseology. All of the routing is correct, nothing needs to be amended.
